roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Owns end-to-end retail analytics across sales, returns and inventory, from the PostgreSQL warehouse and SQL transformation layer to KPI definitions and self-serve Tableau dashboards.
highlights: Architected a retail analytics solution unifying 7 sources (OMS, POS, product master, marketplace, marketing, customer, inventory) into one PostgreSQL warehouse.
Designed a star-schema model with slowly changing dimensions, enabling year-over-year and trend reporting without manual snapshots.
Cut dashboard refresh times by ~50% by diagnosing slow queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE and restructuring joins, filters and indexes.
Automated Python/pandas profiling of daily OMS, POS and marketplace feeds to block duplicate orders, empty files and invalid values before load.
Partnered with finance, merchandising and marketing to define 20+ KPIs, ending conflicting numbers across teams.
Owned OMS-to-marketplace reconciliation; documented fixes became the standard reconciliation process.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Delivered healthcare claims analytics across eligibility, provider, benefits and payment systems for the operations team.
highlights: Tracked claims volume, turnaround time, denial rates and payment discrepancies to flag trends for operations follow-up.
Built reusable Python/pandas data-quality scripts catching duplicate claims, missing or invalid fields and mismatched member/provider IDs.
Reconciled claims, adjustments and payments to source records, confirming reported totals.
Maintained weekly Tableau dashboards of claims KPIs and processing trends for the operations team.
Ran UAT on new claims reports and documented data definitions and KPI logic to keep reporting consistent.

roles.title: Jr Data Analyst
roles.description: Supply-chain, sales and inventory analytics, data ingestion and reporting automation for business stakeholders.
highlights: Reduced delivery time by 25% by analyzing shipment data in Python to pinpoint supply-chain delays and recommending process changes.
Automated data extraction and recurring reporting pipelines, saving ~9 hours of manual work per week.
Built API-based ingestion from the inventory processing application into a Delta Lake on AWS S3, the team's central inventory store.
Built Tableau dashboards tracking supply-chain delays by product and daily revenue by region.
Led analysis projects from design to production, improving data accuracy and customer satisfaction by ~20%.

roles.title: Data Analyst Intern
roles.description: Cleaned operational data and built trend reporting for internal stakeholders.
highlights: Cleaned and standardized operational data in Excel and wrote SQL queries validated against existing reports.
Built pivot-table summaries and charts of monthly operational trends and presented recommendations to internal stakeholders.
Simplified data collection, reducing rework caused by inconsistent entries.
